title: Prime Minister congratulates Kushal Dalal, Sahil Rajesh Jadhav and Ganesh Maniratnam Thirumuru on winning Gold in Men’s Compound Team event at Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Kushal Dalal, Sahil Rajesh Jadhav and Ganesh Maniratnam Thirumuru on winning the Gold medal in the Men’s Compound Team event at the Asian Games.
The Prime Minister said that the trio clinched the Gold after a thrilling final and lauded their superb display of accuracy and teamwork.
Shri Modi extended his best wishes to the champion archers for their future endeavours.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Kushal Dalal, Sahil Rajesh Jadhav and Ganesh Maniratnam Thirumuru clinched Gold in the Men’s Compound Team event at the Asian Games after a thrilling final. Theirs was a superb show of accuracy and teamwork. Congratulations to our champion archers. Best wishes for their future endeavours: PM @narendramodi”
